title: Concept: Operating-system command execution enabled in SQL Server in sql — review required
description: In sql, xp_cmdshell is enabled. The procedure executes with the service account, so SQL-level access becomes host-level access; the account often holds more rights than the database needs. Microsoft ships the feature disabled for this reason.
applicability: sql SQL Server instances configured through scripts.
risk: Host command execution from a database session; HIGH severity.
